decisions: Normalize only the pop decimal separator from comma to dot and CSV encoding/delimiter. Preserve numeric precision and all categorical strings, including trailing whitespace. Retain source municipal files as inputs without deriving new impact maps.

population_interpretation.source_typology: Total Population and High vulnerability are overlapping populations, not additive categories.
population_interpretation.pop: Published additional exposure attributed to Amazon rainforest deforestation, in millions of people; the Total Population label is the full affected population, and High vulnerability is its subset.

threshold_interpretation.source_table: number_population_figure3.csv labels in-shade WBGT >34°C and outdoor WBGT >40°C.
threshold_interpretation.paper_wording: The paper also uses ≥34°C for in-shade extreme risk (PDF p.5; Population analysis, p.6). The exact boundary has not been reconciled with the deposited calculation.
threshold_interpretation.interpretation: Retain source labels. The two exposure settings use different thresholds; population totals do not directly compare hazards in shade and outdoors.
